name: Improved Transfer (Psionic)
body:
Your transfer wounds ability is more potent than most members of your race.

Prerequisite: Transfer wounds class feature, elan.

Benefit: When you use your transfer wounds ability, you roll d8s instead of d6s to determine how much damage you heal.

Normal: Transfer wounds heals damage using a number of d6s based on the vitalist’s level.
